name: Bone Dive
purpose: The fullback straight up the middle, right now. This is the play that has to work before anything else in the formation does — it is what holds their linebackers inside.

LE.rule: Block back and cut off pursuit. You are the last one to the ball.

LT.rule: Block back. Take the first defender on or inside you. Nobody crosses your face.

LG.rule: Block the man over you and drive him off the ball.

C.rule: Snap and block the man over you. If nobody is over you, climb to the middle linebacker.

RG.rule: Block the man over you and drive him off the ball.

RT.rule: Block back. Take the first defender on or inside you. Nobody crosses your face.

RE.rule: Block back and cut off pursuit. You are the last one to the ball.

QB.rule: Take the snap and hand the ball to the fullback at two yards. Then fake to the outside.

FB.rule: Run straight ahead behind the center. Take the ball and get north — there is no hole to look for.

LH.rule: Run the pitch path to your side at full speed and sell it.

RH.rule: Run the pitch path to your side at full speed and sell it.

coaching_points: Both halfbacks run their fakes every single time. Three threats or none.
The fullback does not read anything. He runs at the center's back and keeps his feet moving.
